title: An EmDash site's container runs an init, and the custody matchers still know its compose
steps: S1: render an EmDash site's compose in every custody environment.
S2: classify the render, the render without init, init out of place, and init put back by the frame-policy recreate, with both matchers.
S3: reconcile the frame policy of an EmDash site whose compose has no init.
expect: S1: init: true sits right under restart: unless-stopped.
S2: protected, protected, unknown, and byte-identical to the render.
S3: the recreate adds init: true in that place, once; a compose of another form is left alone.
evidence: Issue #205: every EmDash recreate waited Docker's stop timeout (node as PID 1): measured 5.0 s without an init, 0.8 s with one

tests: EmDash custody forms are the generator's own output (a short label, production defaults)
emdash: the policy recreate adds init: true under restart, once, and nothing else (#205)
